newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah stable, swaps fall after rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah stable, swaps fall after rate cut.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in moderate late trading on Wednesday, but long-term swap rates fell after a cut in the key discount rate, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was generally stable and was last quoted at 2,396.25/96.60 at 0905 GMT from 2,395.80/96.80 at the opening.
"Rupiah liquidity, which is expected to remain generally adequate in longer term, and the discount rate cut partly led to falls in long-term swap rates," one European bank dealer said.
